_note: Wild Pathways 2B: voyages and overland routes on the pathways. Trips live in lib/content/trips (repo content, not the library), so their classification lives here. Drafted by Iggi from each route's own copy, 31 Oct 2026; status flips to approved only on James's word. volumes use the live keys.

records.why: Wayag's lagoons, the Passage and Arborek's mantas: islands and oceans first; the far north of Raja Ampat is still off most maps.
Padar, Pink Beach and mantas by sea; the dragons on Rinca put wildlife second.
South to 66°33′S: the edge of the map, with the Peninsula's penguins, seals and whales along the way.
Tortuguero, Arenal and Monteverde are rainforest and cloud forest; Nosara and the Caribbean add the two coasts.
Monteverde's cloud forest, then adults-only Kura above Uvita: green first, stillness second.
Cloud forest to the Pacific, over the border to Isla Palenque: green, then an island.
Aguas Claras on the Caribbean, Monteverde, Arenas del Mar on the Pacific: rainforest between two seas, a surf day on each.
Three nights at Londolozi on the Sand River, then Ellerman House and Leeu Estates: wild first, Cape heritage second.
A photographic safari at Londolozi Varty Camp with a private vehicle: wildlife, entirely.
Boyd Varty's tracking and coaching retreat: restoration is the point; the bush is the setting.
Pioneer Camp taken as a private homestead for up to 12 with its own Land Rover: a place of your own, on safari.
